title: Port Berth Safety Surveillance
tagline: A virtual line that alarms the second someone crosses it.

meta.title: Port Berth Safety Surveillance | Foxtroit AI
meta.description: A virtual line that alarms the second someone crosses it.

blocks.title: The Problem
blocks.content: Workers can unconsciously cross the safety line near a berthed ship during loading, and manual supervision can't reliably cover a jetty that stretches hundreds of meters.

blocks.title: The Solution
blocks.content: High-resolution PTZ cameras feed a Jetson-based edge processor running human detection and virtual line-crossing logic, triggering a hooter through a Raspberry Pi relay layer — no internet dependency.

blocks.title: Outcome
blocks.content: Eliminates the specific risk of severe injury near berthed ships, with zero reliance on manual monitoring teams.
